Area Forecast Discussion
National Weather Service Chicago/Romeoville, IL
1223 PM CDT Mon Oct 19 2026

.KEY MESSAGES...

- Shallow fog may develop in northeastern Illinois early Tuesday
  morning. Any fog would dissipate a few hours after sunrise. 

- An extended period of dry and above to much above average 
  temperatures is expected through the next 7 days.

&&

.DISCUSSION...
Issued at 1223 PM CDT Mon Oct 19 2026

The only item of note is a threat for shallow fog overnight into
tomorrow morning near Lake Michigan where a modestly more moist
environment will advect inland. Otherwise, no significant 
weather is expected the next 7 days with above to much above 
average temperatures each day. Generally light winds should 
allow weak lake breezes to form each of the next several 
afternoons, but probably only result in slightly cooler 
conditions right near the lake. Other than a bit of mid-high 
level cloudiness this afternoon, much of the week looks to be 
mostly sunny.

- Izzi/Borchardt

&&

.AVIATION /18Z TAFS THROUGH 00Z WEDNESDAY/...
Issued at 1214 PM CDT Mon Oct 19 2026

Light and variable winds (at times prevailing out of the east)
will prevail through the TAF period. Shallow ground fog may
develop in the vicinity of ORD/MDW early tomorrow morning
(08-13Z timeframe), so will introduce targeted TEMPO groups for
1 1/2SM BR. Otherwise, there are no aviation concerns through 
the TAF period. 

Borchardt
